parameter_status: Frozen relative design targets, not fossil measurements. Maker may solve local transitions inside this form envelope; taxon, horn topology and budget changes require a recorded brief revision.
basis: All normalized lengths use head-to-rump length L=4.4 m; values are original modeling choices informed by the reference ledger.

nasal_processes.anatomical_position: paired left/right frontonasal, not tandem on centerline
nasal_processes.shape: short stout outward/upward/forward processes, rounded subtly flattened tips; skin-adjacent surface covering is inferred
nasal_processes.note: Match robust AMNH 518 reference character; do not replace with tall thin prongs from another horn morph.

feet.toe_style: compact rounded hoof-like ends with shallow visible clefts, not sharp claws

shading: intentional faceted primary and secondary forms, slight selective smoothing only if exported normals retain planes

texture_budget.reason: Shape-first original geometry with a small portable PBR palette. Reference photographs are not textures.

render_plan.background: transparent or neutral, consistent exact-GLB evidence

dependency_policy: Use only declared package-relative files under source/deps. Copy version-pinned canonical helper when making begins; do not import another asset directory. Two isolated builds must establish runtime closure.
